app.title: Gratitude Journal
app.subtitle: Shift your focus to the positive

startScreen.title: Gratitude Journal
description: Practicing gratitude has been shown to improve mental health and strengthen relationships.
Take a moment to appreciate the good in your life.
Share these with someone, or reflect on them yourself.

endScreen.title: Heart Full
endScreen.subtitle: Carrying a sense of gratitude can transform your perspective. Keep looking for the good.

gratitude.name: Gratitude
gratitude.description: Questions to help you recognize and appreciate the positives.

questions.question: What is a small thing that happened today that made you smile?
Who is someone you are grateful to have in your life, and why?
What is a challenge you've overcome that you are now thankful for?
What is a possession you own that makes your life easier or more enjoyable?
Describe a favorite memory that always brings you joy.
What is something about your body or health that you appreciate?
What is a skill or talent you have that you are grateful for?
What is something in nature that you find beautiful?
What is a lesson you learned recently that you value?
What is something you are looking forward to in the near future?
